CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2567 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 54bf182104e450c0ac2e6eb007da59b9315e0565. Bus nonce: 84c4ff91ffe593f474b8b71e65da7c72. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 54bf182104e450c0ac2e6eb007da59b9315e0565`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 54bf182104e450c0ac2e6eb007da59b9315e0565` or `Fix review: blocked 54bf182104e450c0ac2e6eb007da59b9315e0565 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 84c4ff91ffe593f474b8b71e65da7c72`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `54bf182104e450c0ac2e6eb007da59b9315e0565` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2567 54bf182104e450c0ac2e6eb007da59b9315e0565") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2567-84c4ff91`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2567 (branch fix/r10-row-only-update), round 5, SAME head as round 4 (no code change). The round-4 verdict (review 21141036) found the code sound (W11 killed, all mutants killed, null control, self-tests 182/0) and blocked only on `carry-missing`: the Forward-carry to R10-POLICY-FIXER-MD was not in the roster tree. Since then: (1) the carry is on the round roster branch: handoff/audit-r10-roster at c185c7257199e3e420b29329a787edd52ab12252 (R10-POLICY-FIXER-MD carry list, last entry 'Source: #2567 Forward-carry. prepr.sh does not run carry_audit.py check ...'); (2) the live PR body was patched at the unchanged head (K14 interim, first live run) to name that roster commit in the Forward-carry item; offline policy_lint --pr-body and carry_audit check --body pass. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Re-run the step-1 mutation proof on at least W11 and two other arms, and the finder's harness at both ends, so the verdict stands on your own measurement. The two round-4 non-blocking items f053a70e and d3bf9b75: if the round-4 verdict already routed them, say so; otherwise add `Carry: dismissed: the round-3 body was re-taken whole and no longer says this (item f053a70e)` and the same for d3bf9b75. Step 11 stands on a green pr-contract run that started after the body edit concluded: post your verdict only after the required checks at this head have concluded (one stale 'Analyze (python)' check-run was re-run); read the check-runs API once at the end and say which are still running.
